Southern? | fam3 = [[Paresi–Waura languages|Paresí–Xingu]]? | fam4 = Waurá? | iso3 = avo | glotto = agav1236 | glottorefname = Agavotaguerra | ethnicity = {{ill|Agavotoqëng|hr|Agavotokueng}} | fam5 = [[Yawalapití language|Yawalapití]] | altname = Agavotocueng }} '''Agavotaguerra''' (Agavotoqueng) is a supposed, extinct [[Arawakan languages|Arawakan language]] of [[Brazil]]. ''Ethnologue'' leaves it "unclassified", but notes that it is related to [[Waura language|Waura]] and [[Yawalapití language|Yawalapiti]], which suggests that it is an [[Arawakan language]] of the Xingu group. ''Glottolog'' states that it is [[Attested language|unattested]], which suggests that any classification is ethnic rather than linguistic.{{Cite web |title=Glottolog 5.1 - Agavotaguerra |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/agav1236 |access-date=2025-02-02 |website=glottolog.org}} According to the [[Kuikuro]], the Agavotoqëng speak the same language as the [[Yawalapiti]].{{Cite journal |last=Hammarström |first=Harald |date=September 2015 |title=Ethnologue 16/17/18th editions: A comprehensive review: Online appendices |url=https://muse.jhu.edu/article/593411 |journal=Language |language=en |volume=91 |issue=3 |pages=s1–s188 |doi=10.1353/lan.2015.0049 |issn=1535-0665|hdl=11858/00-001M-0000-0029-1D58-0 |hdl-access=free |url-access=subscription }} ==References== {{Reflist}} *[http://www.language-archives.org/language/avo OLAC resources in and about the Agavotaguerra language] {{Arawakan languages}} [[Category:Arawakan languages]] {{Arawakan-lang-stub}}
